0.original: Cassard stands at the entrance to Mord Souq, an eager smile on his face.

25.original: Speak with Rhon Ron, and browse the available wares.

48.original: Mord Souq... Not just full of Mord, but Humes and all manner of others, too! It has long been a refuge for folk displaced by the Flood, so the population is nothing if not diverse.

49.original: Oh, have you met a Mord before? They might look like shifty little blighters, but a more welcoming lot you could never wish to meet!

50.original: Speaking of which, we should pay our respects to Master Ghen Gen. I'll go ahead and let him know we've arrived.

51.original: Go on! Introduce yourself to Master Ghen Gen!

52.original: A full Voeburtite honor seems a bit rich for buying a dented pan or a bowl of worms. Did the Exarch lose to you at cards or something!?

53.original: Rhon Ron's shop is best for eating! Crack your coinpurse and gorge on the delicious delicacies!

54.original: Welcome to Rhon Ron's, traveler! I have wares to empty your purse and fill your belly!

55.original: Take your time! Stare and sniff before you choose! But no drooling on the merchandise, yes?

56.original: Browse Rhon Ron's wares. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a foodstuff and inspect it with <hex:020825E4E95101FF10024804F2022203EE81910248020103FF0E021E021003202F20021E02090303>.

57.original: They all look tasty, yes? Which to choose, which to choose!

63.original: Ah, very wise! You won't wither on the sands with a gut full of cactus fruit filling!

65.original: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you forty loaves of bread!

66.original: Yes, put some spice in your step! You won't feel the cold this night...and probably not the next one either!

68.original: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you ten sides of lizard meat!

69.original: Mmm, chewy! A quick, easy meal to carry you across the desert!

71.original: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you sixty-five skewers!

72.original: Too good to resist, eh? (That's what I would've chosen!)

74.original: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you fifteen jars!

78.original: What an appetite! What a belly! A new legend is born in Mord Souq!

79.original: Our visitor invites us to feast! Let us give thanks for <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> great generosity─and small appetite!

80.original: Consider your coinpurse cracked! I am pleased to accept your custom, and Ghen Gen will be pleased that you honored ours!

81.original: ...Keeping the merchandise down, yes? No returns!

82.original: I am honored to have been chosen! Go to Ghen Gen! Let him know that your coinpurse has been most decidedly cracked.

83.original: I've never seen anyone eat so much of Rhon Ron's “cuisine” in one sitting... You've a stronger stomach than I!

84.original: I was watching from here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You honored our custom, and with great relish!

85.original: You will always be welcome in Mord Souq─if you need anything in Amh Araeng, we are here to provide!
